description: Track class attendance: roster with present/absent marks per date and % summaries.

faqs.a: Add student names to the roster, pick a date, then click Present or Absent next to each name. Marks are saved per date.
Change the date picker and mark again — each date has its own record.
faqs.q: How do I record a different day?

faqs.a: The summary shows per-student: present days, total days, and attendance %.
In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: Add student names to the roster.
Click Present or Absent for each student — saved automatically.
View per-student attendance % in the summary.
title: Attendance Tracker
